intro: Ordering hoodies for a team, a class, a company or a merch drop is mostly a maths problem: price per piece, how many of each size, which colours, and whether everything arrives before the deadline. This guide works through all four with live prices, so you can budget an order of 10 or 500 hoodies in a few minutes.

body_html:
What does a hoodie cost in bulk?

For blank hoodies the price per piece falls quickly and then flattens out. At {{SHOP|Marmalade Co.}}, our top pick for bulk orders without a trade account, the Fruit of the Loom hoodie costs €20.95 for one piece, 5 % less from 3 pieces and 10 % less from 5 pieces — €18.86 each. Because shipping is one flat €7 per order, the fee almost disappears in larger orders:

  • 10 hoodies: approx. €195.55 delivered — €19.56 each
  • 50 hoodies: approx. €949.75 — €19.00 each
  • 100 hoodies: approx. €1,892.50 — €18.93 each
  • 250 hoodies: approx. €4,720.75 — €18.88 each

All prices include VAT, so the number above is what a club, school or small business actually pays. The live table below updates every week, together with the zip hoodie and the crewneck sweatshirt for comparison. If the budget is tight, the crewneck sweatshirt uses the same 280 g/m² fabric at a lower price per piece; the zip hoodie costs more but is often preferred for staff who wear it all day.

{{PRICES:hoodie,zip-hoodie,sweatshirt}}

Which Fruit of the Loom hoodie should you buy in bulk?

Pick one model for the whole order. Mixing models means different fits, different shades of the "same" colour and a harder reorder later. The European range has four hoodies worth knowing:

How to split sizes in a bulk order

The best size split is the one you collect from the people who will wear the hoodies. Ask for chest measurements or let people try a sample, then order to that list. If you have to guess — for example for merch or spares — a common starting point for a mixed adult group is:

  • S: approx. 10–15 %
  • M: approx. 25–30 %
  • L: approx. 25–30 %
  • XL: approx. 15–20 %
  • XXL–XXXL: approx. 5–10 %

This is a rule of thumb, not a statistic: a youth club skews smaller, a construction crew larger. Add two or three spares in M and L for late sign-ups. Fruit of the Loom hoodies are a regular unisex fit; the chest in cm runs roughly S 89–94, M 95–100, L 101–106 and XL 107–112. The {{LINK:size-guide|size guide}} has the full chart and a note on shrinkage.

Colours: what to check before ordering 50+ pieces

  • Stay within one model. The quantity discount applies per product, and you can mix colours and sizes of the same hoodie to reach 5 pieces.
  • Heather colours contain more polyester. Heather grey is popular and hides wear, but prints and dyes behave slightly differently than on solid colours.
  • Check stock per size. For large orders, confirm that every size you need is in stock in your colour before paying — especially XS and XXXL.
  • Plan reorders. Note the exact model and colour name. A reorder of the same model gives the most consistent shade.

How long does a bulk hoodie order take?

Blank hoodies from Marmalade Co. are dispatched within 0–1 business day and arrive in 2–3 business days by DHL, with tracking by e-mail. If the hoodies are going to a printer, add the printer's lead time — usually one to two weeks for screen printing or embroidery, sometimes longer in the busy weeks before school leavers' events and Christmas. For a deadline, work backwards: event date, minus printing time, minus a few days buffer, minus delivery. Our {{LINK:team-hoodies|guide to class and team hoodies}} has a full ordering timeline.

Blank or printed: how much does printing add?

Many buyers order blank hoodies and bring them to a local printer, because it lets them choose the cheapest garment route and the printer separately. Printing costs depend on the method, the number of colours and the quantity: screen printing gets cheap per piece from a few dozen hoodies upward, embroidery suits small logos on staff hoodies, and DTG or vinyl works for small runs and individual names. Ask the printer whether they accept supplied garments and whether they charge a handling fee. See our {{LINK:printing|guide to clothing for printing}} for which technique fits which job.

Work out your own order

Choose the hoodie, zip hoodie or sweatshirt and enter your quantity. The total includes the quantity discount and shipping.

For orders of several hundred pieces, a VAT-registered business may also compare trade prices from textile wholesalers; our {{LINK:wholesale|wholesale guide}} explains when that route is cheaper once VAT and cross-border shipping are added.

Checklist for ordering hoodies in bulk

  1. Choose one model — usually the Classic Hooded Sweat, 280 g/m².
  2. Collect sizes from the wearers and add a few spares in M and L.
  3. Choose colours and check stock per size before paying.
  4. Check the deadline against delivery (2–3 business days) plus printing time.
  5. Compare prices on the same basis: VAT included, shipping to your address.

faq.q: How much does it cost to buy 50 hoodies?
faq.a: At Marmalade Co. 50 Fruit of the Loom Classic hoodies cost approx. €942.75 with the automatic 10 % quantity discount, plus one flat €7 DHL fee — approx. €949.75 delivered, or about €19.00 per hoodie, VAT included. Sizes and colours of the same hoodie can be mixed. Printing or embroidery is extra and depends on the method and number of colours.

faq.q: What is the cheapest way to buy hoodies in bulk?
faq.a: For most buyers without a trade account, a retailer with quantity discounts is the cheapest practical route. Marmalade Co. sells the Fruit of the Loom hoodie at €18.86 each from 5 pieces, VAT included, with a flat €7 shipping fee and a price guarantee. VAT-registered businesses ordering several hundred pieces can also compare net prices from textile wholesalers.

faq.q: Is there a minimum order for bulk hoodies?
faq.a: Not at Marmalade Co.: you can buy one hoodie, and the discount starts at 3 pieces (5 %) and rises to 10 % from 5 pieces of the same product. Minimums usually come from printers, not garment sellers — screen printing often starts at around 10–25 pieces per design, while embroidery and DTG shops can do smaller runs at a higher price per piece.

faq.q: Which Fruit of the Loom hoodie is best for printing?
faq.a: The Classic Hooded Sweat (62-208) is the usual choice. It weighs 280 g/m², is 80 % cotton and 20 % polyester, and uses Belcoro® yarn on the outer surface, which gives a smooth base for screen printing, transfers and embroidery. It is also the most widely stocked model, which makes reorders in the same shade easier.

faq.q: How long does delivery take for a bulk hoodie order?
faq.a: Marmalade Co. dispatches within 0–1 business day and delivers in 2–3 business days by DHL to 11 EU countries, with tracking by e-mail. If the hoodies are going to a printer, add one to two weeks for printing, and more in busy seasons such as the weeks before Christmas or school leavers' events.

faq.q: Can I mix sizes and colours and still get the bulk discount?
faq.a: Yes. At Marmalade Co. the quantity discount applies per product, so different sizes and colours of the same Fruit of the Loom hoodie count together towards the 3- and 5-piece thresholds. Mixing the hoodie with a different product, such as the zip hoodie or the sweatshirt, counts separately for each product.
